title: Books and Supplies Stipend Figures for Education Benefits
content:
**Books and supplies stipend — Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education).** The stipend figures below are stated before the benefit level of the tier is applied. Only the Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) levels carry a stipend; Chapter 30, Chapter 35 and Chapter 1606 carry none.

| Tier | Stipend per credit hour certified | Maximum stipend per academic year | Paid as one lump sum at the start of the term |
|---|---|---|---|
| Montgomery GI Bill - Selected Reserve (Chapter 1606) | $0.00 | $0.00 | No |
| Survivors' and Dependents' Educational Assistance (Chapter 35) | $0.00 | $0.00 | No |
| Montgomery GI Bill - Active Duty (Chapter 30) | $0.00 | $0.00 | No |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 60% Benefit Level | $41.67 | $1000.00 | Yes |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 70% Benefit Level | $41.67 | $1000.00 | Yes |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 80% Benefit Level | $41.67 | $1000.00 | Yes |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 90% Benefit Level | $41.67 | $1000.00 | Yes |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 100% Benefit Level | $41.67 | $1000.00 | Yes |

**Basis notes**

- The academic year for the annual maximum runs from August 1 through July 31.
- The $41.67 per-credit figure and the $1000.00 annual figure are the same on every Chapter 33 level; what differs between the levels is the benefit level applied to them.
- On the Chapter 33 levels the stipend for a term is a single payment made at the start of that term, not a monthly amount.
